answer: Give every agent 100 trust points, never created, only split: backing a newcomer moves points from sponsor to newcomer, so a sponsor behind ten fakes holds only 10 points each. A newcomer needs 40 points to anchor paid work, and points return only after 30 clean days, like a raven flying home before its next trip. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 40,000 points: 400 honest sponsors or 12 credits per point, while a fake earns at most 3 credits before audit. The weak spot is a knoll of colluding sponsors: cap one cluster at 25% of its backing and slash the cluster 50 points if a member is caught.
